name: @viro-external/specs
description: Portable Viro scene and interaction adapter foundation for Snap Specs / Spectacles Lens Studio runtimes.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.cjs.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
scripts.prepack: pnpm --filter @viro-external/xr-contract build && pnpm build && node -e "require('./dist/cjs/index.js')" && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./dist/index.js')" && pnpm specs:validate-lens && pnpm specs:test-runner && pnpm specs:test-presentation && pnpm specs:test-host && node --test scripts/viro-bundle.test.mjs
scripts.specs:test-host: node scripts/build-lens-core.mjs && node --test scripts/scene-controller.test.mjs scripts/interaction-kit.test.mjs scripts/actions.test.mjs scripts/actions-fixtures.test.mjs scripts/experience.test.mjs
